statistical_methodology.cv_protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed) grouped by family_id, with TF-IDF + balanced LogisticRegression refitted inside every fold. Stratum-controlled probes restrict to shared strata and apply inverse-stratum-count sample weights during fitting.
statistical_methodology.plus_minus_definition: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of pooled out-of-fold (OOF) ROC-AUC across the 10 random CV fold-assignment seeds (42..51). Quantifies CV split-randomization variability on the fixed finite dataset; NOT standard error of the mean and NOT generalization uncertainty to unseen data.

ci_95_definitions.bootstrap_95ci_seed42: Stratified percentile bootstrap (B=1,000, [2.5, 97.5] percentiles) on seed=42 OOF predictions.
ci_95_definitions.bootstrap_95ci_mean_oof: Stratified percentile bootstrap (B=1,000, [2.5, 97.5] percentiles) on 10-seed averaged OOF probabilities per row.
ci_95_definitions.cluster_bootstrap_95ci_mean_oof: Family-cluster stratified percentile bootstrap (B=1,000, resampling family_id clusters with replacement within class) on 10-seed averaged OOF probabilities.
ci_95_definitions.generalization_caveat: OOF bootstrap CIs measure finite-sample score uncertainty conditional on the fixed training pool; they do NOT capture model-fitting variance or true out-of-sample generalization error to unseen distributions.

statistical_methodology.surface_auc_orientation_note: Positive class is verified to be is_synthetic_bin == 1 (clf.classes_ == [0, 1] in every fold, score = predict_proba[:, 1]). Values slightly below 0.50 under stratum-balanced weighting with small N_syn reflect near-chance separability amplified downward by leave-one-fold-out anti-correlation across balanced strata, NOT inverted class labels.
statistical_methodology.cohort_comparability_warning: Cohorts differ in synthetic sample size (N_syn = 50, 250, 261, 300, 561) and matched-stratum coverage. Do NOT claim statistically significant improvement from comparing AUCs across unequal-N_syn or unequally matched cohorts.
statistical_methodology.brand_detection_definition: Unified schema.detect_brand_mentions + schema.mask_brands + schema.DEFAULT_KNOWN_BRANDS (Real BD + Pilot + Batch 1-5) + Batch 6 brand_registry.json, with NFC normalization, contact-masking before brand checks, and full Bengali (-য়/-য়/-য়ে/-ের/-এ/-এর/-ে/-তে/-কে/-র/-দের) and Banglish (-er/-e/-te/-ke/-r/-y/-ye/-der) inflection support.
